name: Liselotte Shubert
original_name: リーゼロッテ・シュレーベル
source: Liselotte is a wealthy transfer student from America who came to the village for a certain purpose. She has a bright personality and likes to smile. She plays a cello, which she was taught by her mother, and likes to compete with Ai all the time.
